title: "[Bug] "
labels: ""

---

## Problem

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduction

1. Configuration and sample synthetic input.
2. Steps to reproduce.
3. Observed result.

## Environment

Commit, operating system, browser, and relevant package versions.

## Evidence

Include sanitized errors or screenshots. Use synthetic examples; do not include passwords, tokens, private login logs, or personal data. Report vulnerabilities privately according to SECURITY.md.
